verdict.rationale: The evidence shows built-in automatic tax calculation, filing and remittance, plus compliance tracking and alerts. These are fixed vendor-run processes, not automations the user sets up to run in the background. The APIs, webhooks and the 'Recurring Deduction' use case are developer building blocks for integrations, not a documented user-facing way to configure autonomous automations, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
